fusions.name: Correct Pronunciation
fusions.desc: Looses 5 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage that ignores resistances, with a 50% chance per hit to leave the target [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Clause
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 15 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Practiced Croak
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Margin Note
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
